title: Metabolic Marathon — Metabolism
author: Dr. Dan (ItsDrDan)
description: Practice CHEM 3B metabolism (Chapters 13–15) with Mito the marathon mitochondrion. Five groups open 22 topics: Pathways (big picture, glucose pathways, where it happens in the cell, reading diagrams of glycolysis, the citric acid cycle, β-oxidation, the urea cycle and the electron transport chain, putting steps in order), ATP Accounting (NADH/FADH2/ATP counts, fatty acid ATP, carbon tracking, ATP and energy), Reactions & Coenzymes (name the reaction, which coenzyme, predict the product, enzyme classes, vitamins) and Fuel Fates & Health (fed/fasting/exercise scenarios, hormones and regulation, protein and nitrogen, nursing and dental cases) and Rosa’s Case Files (four case files that follow Rosa, the textbook’s patient with type 2 diabetes, through a low blood sugar in the dental chair, an evening walk, a sick day with ketones and BUN, and her medicines). Plus a 10-question Exam Prep Check with a study plan and the Final Boss metabolism questions.
